Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed classroom counts, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessments with categories and detailed system evaluations; integration of condition data with long-term planning (Sections 4.1-4.20, Appendix 5.2).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections through 2023/24 with methodology, cohort analyses, and capacity utilization by site and grade; clear connection of projections to facility needs and potential expansions (Section 2.2, Appendix 5.2).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational program vision, specifications for flexible and technology-rich classrooms, specialized program spaces (CTE, special education, STEAM), and integration of facilities with instructional goals (Sections 2.3, 3.0, Meeting Minutes 5.1).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with references to shade structures, play apparatus, and outdoor learning courts; strategies for improvement mentioned but not fully districtwide or detailed (Sections 2.3, site plans, and Meeting Minutes).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate-related concerns such as drought and energy conservation; however, lacks comprehensive climate risk assessment or detailed mitigation strategies across the district (Meeting Minutes 5.1, Energy Focus Group).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Discusses energy efficiency strategies including LED lighting upgrades, solar carports, EMS systems, and HVAC replacements; references to Title 24 and state goals are implicit; energy resilience goals mentioned but not fully detailed (Energy Focus Group, Meeting Minutes).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates, prioritization framework, multiple funding sources including bonds and state grants, and phased implementation plan; includes prioritization exercises and financial projections (Section 3, Meeting Minutes 5.1, 6).
